title: Input coordinate embedding
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs and $g$ gates. The input-coordinate embedding sends each input position among the $n$ input positions to the corresponding position among the first $n$ coordinates of the combined set of $n+g$ input and gate coordinates.
